resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO v7.2 or CP2K v2024.1)

access.notes: Use an open-source DFT implementation capable of PBE, HSE06, and Grimme D2 van der Waals correction. Alternative: CP2K (https://www.cp2k.org/).

resources.name: PBE pseudopotential library (e.g., SSSP efficiency for PWscf or GTH for CP2K)

access.notes: Choose PBE pseudopotentials appropriate for S, Se, P, Mo, W.

resources.name: Initial crystal structures of blueP, SMoSe, and SWSe monolayers

access.notes: Provide lattice constants and atomic positions as described in the paper: blueP: a=3.27 Å, P-P bond ~2.25 Å; SMoSe: a=3.26 Å; SWSe: a=3.26 Å. Monolayer structures can be generated from standard hexagonal unit cells using these parameters. Stacking models (SMSe and SeMS) are described in the task instructions.
